<!-- stormworks-research-gap:tool:cooling-flow -->
This issue tracks explicit open questions in the [wiki](https://sw-wiki.maxsp.de/tools/cooling).

The quotations below preserve the scope of each source. A resource-only article can lack a formula that a separate native-code investigation has partly recovered. Reconcile those findings before treating every quoted item as wholly undecoded.

## Recorded gaps

**Application text**

> How fast fluid moves between ports was not recovered. Real flow restrictions can raise the required count.

- [wiki/app/tools/cooling/page.jsx](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/app/tools/cooling/page.jsx#L193), `line:193`

**Application text**

> Assumes ideal pump flow: every radiator full of clean fresh water as hot as the coolant manifold. Pump throughput was not recovered,

- [wiki/components/CoolingCalculator.jsx](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/components/CoolingCalculator.jsx#L548), `line:548`

## Completion criteria

- Recover the relevant routine or run a reproducible measurement against the identified game build.
- Record equations, units, bounds, assumptions and executable addresses or measurement inputs.
- Update the wiki guidance and its extractor, retaining citations and any remaining uncertainty.
- Add or update an interactive graph when the recovered formula supports one.
- Re-run the relevant source checks and website checks.
title: Cooling calculator: recover real pump throughput and fluid transport
